title: This or That? Animals Edition!
description:
Can you pick the right animal?! 15 questions from easy to IMPOSSIBLE. Fun for the whole family!

Drop your score in the comments!

👍 Like | 🔔 Subscribe | 💬 Comment your answers below!

#ThisOrThat #AnimalFacts #FamilyFriendly #KidsVideo #AnimalTrivia
intro: Hey hey hey and welcome back! Today we are playing This or That — Animal Edition! I am going to give you two animals and you pick one. We start easy and get seriously tricky. Grab a friend, pause when I say go, and keep score. Are you ready? Let's go!

questions.question: Which animal is bigger?
questions.explanation: A full grown tiger can weigh up to 660 pounds. That is like a very large motorcycle!

questions.question: Which animal lays eggs?
questions.explanation: Dolphins are mammals just like us, so they give birth to live baby dolphins called calves!

questions.question: Which one is faster?
questions.explanation: A cheetah hits 70 miles per hour. A tortoise maxes out at 0.17 miles per hour. No contest!

questions.question: Which animal sleeps the most?
questions.explanation: Koalas sleep up to 22 hours a day! Sloths sleep 15 to 20 hours. Both are professional nappers but koala wins!

questions.question: Which animal has more legs?
questions.explanation: Crabs have 10 legs, spiders have 8. Crabs win on legs but spiders have extra appendages called pedipalps!

questions.question: Which animal lives longer?
questions.explanation: Some parrots live 60, 70, even 80 years! There are parrots alive today that predate your grandparents!

questions.question: Which is technically a fish?
questions.explanation: Neither one is a fish! Starfish are echinoderms and jellyfish are invertebrates. Scientists now call them sea stars and jellies!

questions.question: Which is more closely related to humans?
questions.explanation: Chimps share 98.7 percent of our DNA. Gorillas share 98.3 percent. Both incredibly close but chimps edge it out!

questions.question: Which animal produces silk?
questions.explanation: Both do! Silkworms make fabric silk. Spider silk is stronger per strand than steel. Spiders are the original engineers!

questions.question: Which has fingerprints nearly identical to humans?
questions.explanation: Koala fingerprints have actually confused crime scene investigators before. They evolved completely separately from us!

questions.question: Which animal can see more colors?
questions.explanation: Butterflies can see ultraviolet light invisible to us. Their flowers look completely different to them. Nature has hidden art galleries!

questions.question: Which mammal lays eggs?
questions.explanation: Both are monotremes — mammals that lay eggs. Only five species exist in the world and they all live in Australia!

questions.question: Which is the largest animal ever known?
questions.explanation: The blue whale wins on mass at up to 200 tons. Its heart alone is the size of a small car. The biggest animal in all of history!

questions.question: Which has more neurons in its brain?
questions.explanation: Elephants have 257 billion neurons vs a crow's 1.5 billion. But crows use them so efficiently they can recognize human faces!

questions.question: Which can survive in the vacuum of space?
questions.explanation: The tardigrade, also called a water bear, is basically indestructible. Scientists sent them to space and they survived. The ultimate champion!

fun_facts.text: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance! Say it with me — FLAMBOYANCE!
Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood! And when they swim, their main heart actually stops beating. Relatable.
Cows have best friends. Research shows cows form close bonds and get stressed when separated from their favorite pal.
A snail can sleep for three years. When conditions get too dry or cold, a snail hibernates until things improve.
Wombats are the only animals that produce cube shaped poop. Scientists spent years figuring out how. Nature is never boring.

outro: And that is a wrap on Animal This or That! Drop your score in the comments — no lying! If you got all 15 you are an absolute legend. Smash that like button, hit subscribe, and I will see you in the next one. Bye!
